Unofficial fan project — not affiliated with Nintendo or The Pokémon Company.

This app does not include Pokémon Omega Ruby or Alpha Sapphire. You must select a dump of a game you own.

Milestone A: pick your dump, validate OR/AS, and prepare for an embedded Azahar-class emulator with Thor-tuned defaults.
I own this game and will provide my own dump.
Select a decrypted .3ds or .cci of Omega Ruby or Alpha Sapphire. No ROMs are included with this app.
Dump is registered. Next: embed Azahar core + Thor profile and boot this file.
